committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 21 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The A$600 test credit is now at zero (creditRemainingExGst $0) against total spend of $754.48 ex GST across 108 raw paid clicks; campaign status shows PAUSED, so the pause-unless rule now applies pending a qualified-enquiry check.

No external account changes were recorded in the last 24 hours or 7 days (externalLast24h and externalLast7d both 0), so test data since 6 Oct is not contaminated; impression share sits at only 10% with rank lost at 74.7%, well above budget lost at 16.1%, so no budget action is warranted.
Of the 17 ask_cta_click events logged since the test started, none have converted to a review_cta_click (0), meaning visitors are taking the light first step but not booking the deeper review yet.

Organic Search sessions fell from 12 to 7 week on week, the only unpaid signal worth trusting, while Search Console (through 18 Nov, lagging as usual) shows just 6 clicks from 294 impressions over 8 days, with top queries like 'business automation for tradies' (29 impressions) sitting at position 48.

actions.text: Confirm cost per qualified enquiry against the A$480 cap and check whether a qualified prospect has booked before considering any resume of paid search; the credit is now exhausted at $0 remaining.
With totalPaidClicks at 108, past the 75-click checkpoint, confirm the qualified count in the test log; zero qualified enquiries at this volume would mean the red flag stands.

Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started (eventsSinceStart.generate_lead: 3); check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source data and grade each against the qualified rule in the test log.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.
Logo and image assets are still outstanding for the serving ad groups.
